title: thymus serpyllum subsp. alpestris
intro: Thymus serpyllum subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, native to the alpine regions of the world. Alpine Thyme is a low-growing, woody perennial herb with a long history of use in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as aiding digestion, reducing stress and anxiety, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant's therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat various health conditions.
